label: Synthetic benchmark trace. Not customer data.

cost_assumptions.note: Waste calculated as 18600 tokens × 3 repetitions after first occurrence at 2.5/M input tokens. First occurrence (child-llm-001) excluded. Output tokens not counted because waste is on the input side.

findings.evidence: Detection method: block_id_and_similarity. The "LangSmith input: document" block (18,600 tokens) appears across 4 model calls. Block ID matched (ls_document) and text similarity confirmed (100%). Block was reused 3 times after first occurrence (child-llm-001).
findings.explanation: The "LangSmith input: document" block (18,600 tokens) was included in the model context 4 times but only needed once. After the first use in child-llm-001, the remaining 3 occurrences (child-llm-002, child-llm-003, child-llm-004) passed the same content again, generating an estimated $0.14 in waste. This represents approximately 56% of the total run cost.
findings.recommended_fix: Cache the content of "LangSmith input: document" after child-llm-001. Pass a reference ID or cached summary into later steps (child-llm-002, child-llm-003, child-llm-004) instead of the full block.

cost_caveat: The detected repeated-context waste represents a specific measured inefficiency. It does not represent total potential savings. A full cost comparison requires a before-and-after trace pair.
limitations: Synthetic benchmark trace, not customer data.
Cost estimates use published pricing; actual costs may differ.
